scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Welcome to Morocc,
the frontier town of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
Please ask me for help if
you're having any trouble
finding anything in town.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
欢迎来到梦罗克，卢恩·米德加兹王国的边境城镇。
如果在城里找不到想去的地方，请随时向我求助。

scripts.text: City Guide
scripts.translation: 城市导览

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]

需要我在您的小地图上标记地点吗？

scripts.text:

Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
The Thief Guild is
in charge of all Job
Changes to the Thief
Class. From what I hear,
you can find them inside
the Pyramids nearby...
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[梦罗克向导]
盗贼公会负责办理盗贼的转职手续。
听说他们就在附近的金字塔里...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
The Weapon Shop
is in the southeast
end of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]

[梦罗克向导]
武器店位于梦罗克的东南端。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
There are Inns
where you can rest
at the southeast and
northeast ends of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[梦罗克向导]
梦罗克的东南端和东北端都有旅馆，您可以在那里休息。

scripts.text:

[Morocc Guide]

scripts.translation:

请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[梦罗克向导]
酒馆位于梦罗克东北部。

scripts.text:

[梦罗克向导]
佣兵公会位于梦罗克东部。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
The Forge is
located just
southwest from
the center of Morocc.
scripts.translation:

[梦罗克向导]
锻造所位于梦罗克市中心的西南方。

scripts.text:

the following menu.

Marks from Mini-Map'' if you

[梦罗克向导]

[Morocc Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
如果不想让小地图继续显示地点标记，请选择“移除小地图标记”。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
魔法与科技的进步让我们得以更新信息系统，现在可以在您的小地图上标记地点，方便您辨认方向。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
小地图位于屏幕右上角。
如果看不到，请按Ctrl + Tab，或点击基本信息窗口中的“地图”按钮。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
点击小地图上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或缩小地图。
祝您在梦罗克游历愉快。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Alright then,
try to stay out of
too much trouble
out there, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克向导]
好了，冒险者，在外面小心些，尽量别惹上太多麻烦。
